note: Pre-registered before any run. Never edit after a run; supersede with bl055_criteria_addendum_N.json.
question: Does the volatility-adjusted score improve when it follows the config's selected lookbacks and weights instead of the fixed NSE 26/52-week returns?

variant.flag: engine.Config.voladj_lookbacks = True (a heavy search setting; off by default)
variant.definition: for each selected lookback L: return over L weeks, measured 4 weeks back when L >= 26 and voladj_skip_recent_month is on, else to the latest close; divided by the trailing 26-week volatility of weekly returns; z-scored across the week's eligible names; the score is the weighted sum of the z-scores with the config's lookback weights (equal when none); higher is better. A name needs every component and the volatility to be ranked
variant.applies_to: score 'voladj', and the voladj half of score 'blend'; 'ranksum' is unchanged

strategies: the 11 of bl053_criteria.json except 9f9ef3aa6c1b (ranksum, unaffected): 9 configs on every rebalance phase blended, and the frozen ensemble's four sleeves at their frozen offsets; 10 in all
settings: as bl054_criteria.json: round7_A fixed settings, turnover_rank universe, curated tags, Rs 5 lakh, 2017-01-01 to 2026-10-02, after tax with TaxRules() defaults and pre-tax alongside; scripts/bl054_levers.py lever l7
pass_development_after_tax: median CAGR change >= +1.0 pt over the 10 strategies
CAGR not lower in at least 6 of 10
median worst-fall change no deeper than -2.0 pts
confirm_after_tax: CAGR not lower in at least 5 of 10
verdict: adopt (offer it as an option; the default and the frozen ensemble stay unchanged) only if development passes and confirmation holds; else kill
will_not_run: other volatility windows, other skip rules, per-lookback volatility
a new search over lookbacks or weights with the variant
